McGee Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Senior Lecturer of Business Administration Read more Henry McGee joined the Harvard Business School faculty in 2013 after retiring as President of HBO Home Entertainment, the digital and DVD program distribution division of Home Box Office, the pioneering premium television company. A member of the Entrepreneurial Management unit, he has co-authored numerous cases on the media and cultural industries and co-designed and teaches the course Business of the Arts.
